segments.title: 第42章 當選
segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 42: Elected

Besides Li Luo, not many people in the class went up to run for class monitor.

After Hua Xiuxiu and Shao Heqi, only a female student named Shi Yanran went on stage.

Shao Heqi had been the vice class monitor for three years, while Shi Yanran had participated in numerous local volunteer activities; both had some qualifications to be class monitor.

Other than them, a few boys who were usually more into sports went up to run for sports committee member.

As for the female sports committee member position, no one went up to campaign for it.

Seeing that there was no one else, Li Luo finally stood up from his seat again and walked towards the podium.

"Hello everyone, we meet again. I am Li Luo."

Walking up to the podium, Li Luo greeted everyone and then said with a smile, "I think classmate Hua Xiuxiu said something very true just now."

"She said that a class monitor must first have the corresponding ability, and only then everything else."

"And whether it was Hua Xiuxiu, Shao Heqi before her, or classmate Shi Yanran, they all used their past experiences to bolster their own cases."

"Teacher Kong said earlier that the class monitor is to serve the students."

"I personally think I have a bit of a talent in this area."

As he spoke, Li Luo suddenly stepped down from the podium, stood in the aisle near Kong Junxiang, and stopped by Hua Xiuxiu's desk.

Then he continued, "Hua Xiuxiu, her hobby is reading, and her favorite book is Jane Eyre."

With that, he took a step forward, arriving next to Lin Yuan.

"Lin Yuan, his hobby is playing basketball, and he gets nervous when he goes on stage."

"Zhou Juanling, likes watching movies, especially arthouse films, and has a relatively quiet personality."

"Lu Jiahao, is good at photography, likes small animals, and is very kind-hearted."

"Wang Xinyu, can do some handicrafts, is very good at cross-stitch, and is quite lively and cheerful."

After describing the situation of the entire row of students, Li Luo returned to the podium, cleared his throat with a couple of coughs and said, "I personally believe that to provide good service, one must first understand the specific circumstances of the people being served."

"As a class monitor, the most basic requirement is to at least know the name, personality, and hobbies of every student in the class, so that when help is needed, it can be provided in a targeted manner."

At this point.

Shao Heqi, in the audience, couldn't hold back anymore.

"You didn't memorize the self-introductions of that entire row of people beforehand, did you?"

Li Luo was interrupted by him but didn't seem to mind.

Kong Junxiang, sitting beside them, also had a look on his face like he was watching a show, crossing his legs with great interest. He hadn't expected this student, Li Luo, to be so interesting.

There were also students in the audience who liked to jeer, and after hearing Shao Heqi's doubt, they couldn't help but say, "Yeah, you said you remember everyone's names, what about me?"

"Your name is Zhu Yufei, and you just went up to run for sports committee member," Li Luo smiled, "You said you like to play basketball and can dunk."

"What about me? What about me?" The boy next to Zhu Yufei also jeered, raising his hand to ask.

"Zhang Guohuang, likes to play games, and said he's very good with Yasuo."

"Holy crap, you actually remember?"

Zhang Guohuang cried out in surprise.

The students below watched Li Luo's performance without blinking, clearly stunned by his move.

In the back row, Yan Zhusheng showed a curious and puzzled expression, glanced at Li Luo's desk, and confirmed that he hadn't written any of this down on paper in advance.

"In conclusion, I hope everyone can vote for me. Thank you."

Li Luo finished his speech and returned to his seat.

Seeing that no one else was going on stage to run, Kong Junxiang got up and walked to the podium, picked up a piece of chalk, and drew a circle around the names of the four class monitor candidates, then said with a smile, "Well then, let's start voting."

"There are no voting restrictions, you can vote multiple times."

"As long as you feel that person is competent for the position, you can raise your hand to vote."

"So, let's now elect our class monitor."

Kong Junxiang was indeed efficient. After calling out the names of the four, Li Luo and the others, he counted the number of raised hands and recorded the numbers next to their respective names.

In the end.

Li Luo, with 31 votes, was unquestionably elected as the class monitor of Class Eight, Year One.

Hua Xiuxiu, with 28 votes, came in a close second and was elected vice class monitor.

Shao Heqi ranked third with a total of 20 votes. When the results were announced, he turned his head and gave Li Luo a rather resentful look.

For some reason, ever since the high school entrance exams, nothing related to Li Luo had gone his way.

He had originally thought that even if he couldn't beat Hua Xiuxiu, he could at least continue as the vice class monitor.

But now, even the position of vice class monitor was gone.

This made Shao Heqi extremely upset.

However, Kong Junxiang didn't give him much time to be sad and quickly elected the male sports committee member as well.

The student who was elected was Zhu Yufei, who claimed he could dunk.

As for the female sports committee member...

"Since no female student has volunteered, I will temporarily appoint a student to take the position." Kong Junxiang glanced at the student roster, then said, "Yan Zhusheng?"

"Huh?" Hearing the teacher call her name, Yan Zhusheng, who was sitting next to Li Luo, was slightly taken aback and looked up at the podium.

"I looked at your personal file." Kong Junxiang said, "You broke the school's girls' 100-meter record in middle school, right? How about I temporarily hand over the role of our class's sports committee member to you?"

Hearing the teacher's words, Yan Zhusheng seemed unable to find a suitable reason to refuse at that moment, and in the end, could only nod, "Oh."

"OK, then this morning's task is complete." Kong Junxiang picked up the sealed envelope, tidied up the things on the podium, and then said, "Your student cards are also your cafeteria meal cards, and they've already been pre-loaded with one hundred yuan."

"In a moment at 11:20, after the bell rings for the end of class, you can go have lunch."

"The cafeteria is behind Teaching Building No. 2. Just go downstairs and walk straight along the asphalt road, and you'll see it."

"The school will arrange for physical examinations this afternoon, so after lunch, everyone remember to come back to the classroom to gather."

After saying all this, Kong Junxiang picked up the sealed envelope and walked towards the door. Before leaving, he didn't forget to smile at them:

"As for me, I'll be leaving first. The teachers' cafeteria is already open. See you all this afternoon."

Watching Kong Junxiang's back as he left the classroom, Li Luo suddenly felt that their homeroom teacher was pretty nice.

He didn't look old, probably not even thirty, and had a relaxed way of speaking.

Being the class monitor for such a homeroom teacher probably wouldn't be a distressing matter.

In the classroom, after the homeroom teacher left, everyone was quiet for only a short while.

Seeing that there was still a while before lunch and the teacher wasn't in the classroom, many students began to chat.

Only around Li Luo's area, due to Yan Zhusheng's presence, hardly anyone dared to strike up a conversation.

When the school bell rang at 11:20, the students all stood up and walked out of the classroom, preparing to go to the cafeteria for lunch.

Li Luo also got up and slowly walked towards the staircase.

But just as he stepped out of the back door of the classroom, he saw a slender figure by the staircase, standing on her tiptoes, waving at him from amidst the crowd.

"Li Luo, over here!"

Ying Chanxi jogged over to Li Luo's side, looked up at him and said, "You haven't been to the cafeteria yet, have you? I'll take you."

In an instant, Li Luo felt as if countless sharp, sword-like glares were stabbing into him.

They came not only from Class Eight, but also from the boys of Class One who were going downstairs.

All of them were fixed on him.
